materials.author: Adam H. Grimes
materials.content_note: Sections: Discretionary vs Systematic; Fundamental and Macro; Technicals; Importance of doing your own work; Can the whole be more than the sum of the parts? Includes: macro/fundamental signals are not timing signals; pattern occurrence identification via discretion vs rule set; '100% reliable' pattern claims impossible; context must be quantified; baseline-relative edge analysis.

materials.author: Adam H. Grimes
materials.canonical_title: Reader question: what's wrong with Fibonacci?
materials.content_note: Reply to a reader question. Covers: inability to predict which Fibonacci level will hold; confluence as possible luck; random-data perception study; price-memory reliance on chart adjustment; absence of quantitative proof for Fibonacci; data-supported replacement of ~50% retracement of prior swing with a very large margin of error.
materials.publisher_channel: The Blog of Adam H Grimes (adamhgrimes.com)

materials.author: Adam H. Grimes
materials.canonical_title: Marketlifetrading.com and the free trading course
materials.content_note: Announcement/relaunch of the free trading course. Covers: trading is not a get-rich-quick scheme; cannot learn to trade with a few candlestick patterns; becoming a trader requires changing how you think and handle risk; the author's acknowledged process mistake of making everything free (not sustainable); commitment to free public material plus paid tiers.
